description: One id per fixed sentence that a person reads or hears from an agent: a tool result the model relays, a sentence a tool description tells the model to say, a reply code sends straight to the owner, or text code adds to mail and texts for other people. Both runtimes that say the same thing use the same id and the same exact text. Vault tool words are NOT repeated here: schema/agent/vault-tools.v1.json x-refusals.say and its consts are their single source (x-refs). Model-only instructions, log lines and the services' own server words are out of scope. ONE EXCEPTION to the last clause (1.3.0): when the Windy Text service answers a text in an agent's name on an owner's own number (STOP and HELP; a START is recorded with no reply in the agent's name), those sentences are the agent's words to a person and are listed here with a windy-text source (rule P7).
x-rules: P1 ONE ID, ONE TEXT. An id's say is exact. A runtime that uses an id ships that text byte for byte; its conformance test compares its source with this file (vendored and hash-pinned, like vault-tools.v1).

P2 CHANGES ARE DECISIONS. A new sentence, or a change to one, is a Boss decision plus a non-author #9 fact check recorded in git, plus Windy Legal's LEGAL DECISION line for outbound_text, consent and opt-out phrases, then a version bump here; the runtimes that use it ship the new text together.

P3 TRUE FOR EACH RUNTIME. A sentence must be true for every runtime listed under its runtimes. When the truth differs (P136-5: one runtime can add an event, the other can't), they are TWO ids, each listing only the runtime it is true for.

P4 SLOTS. {name} marks a slot; the slots object names each one and what fills it. A slot carries a value (a name, a number, an address), never a sentence the model wrote, except where the slot says so (sms.first_text_intro's message).
P5 NOTHING SECRET. No phrase holds a token, an id, a key, a URL with a credential, or the content of a message, a file or an email.
P6 runtimes. A runtime's value is where it says this (file and line, or a const), or null when it doesn't use the id yet. null is not a promise to add it.

P7 windy-text. The Windy Text service is not an agent runtime, but since Windy Fly's own texting channel left (windy-agent #788) it is the one place that receives STOP, START and HELP on an owner's own number, and it answers STOP and HELP in the agent's name (a START gets no reply in the agent's name). Those replies are listed here with an optional third source, runtimes.windy-text (file and line), and P1 and P3 hold for it as for a runtime. An entry without that key says nothing about Windy Text. Windy Text's other server words stay out of scope.

sms.optout_unreadable.say: I didn't text that number. I couldn't read my do-not-text list just now, so I can't tell whether they asked me to stop texting them.
sms.optout_unreadable.origin: Windy Legal's words (Legal 2026-11-11T04:55:36Z): when the record cannot be read, the owner is not told the person replied STOP

sms.owner_opted_out.say: You've turned off texts from me, so I didn't send it.

sms.owner_phone_not_set_up.say: Your phone isn't set up for texting yet, so I didn't send it.

sms.owner_phone_not_verified.say: Your phone number isn't verified for texting yet, so I didn't send it.

sms.quiet_hours.say: It's quiet hours for that person, so I didn't send it. I can try in the morning.

sms.recipient_not_consented.say: That person hasn't agreed to get texts from me yet, so I didn't send it.

sms.recipient_opted_out.say: That number has opted out of texts (they replied STOP), so I didn't send it.

sms.sent_without_label.say: That text went out WITHOUT the usual '[name · Windy]' label. Please tell Windy support.

sms.spend_cap.say: Your texting spending limit has been reached, so I didn't send it.

sms.standing.say: My Eternitas standing doesn't allow sending texts right now, so I didn't send it.

sms.too_many_requests.say: There are already a lot of texting requests waiting for your OK in Windy. Please review them first.

sms.twilio_key_invalid.say: Your Twilio key isn't working, so I didn't send it. Please reconnect Twilio.

sms.unavailable.say: Texting isn't available yet; I can reach them by email or you can message them in Windy Chat.

sms.unsubscribed.say: You're unsubscribed and won't get more texts from this number. Reply START to get them again.
sms.unsubscribed.origin: LEGAL DECISION 28 (1) (Legal 2026-11-09T11:14:19Z): an opt-out confirmation says what stops. Its fact gate is met: START clears Windy's own record (windy-text service/app/byo/messaging.py). Windy Fly no longer says it: its own texting channel left in windy-agent #788 (8824dc47)

sms.wont_text_number.say: OK, I won't text that number.

team.agent_not_found.say: I couldn't find that agent among your agents.

slots.name: the agent's name (or its passport number when it has none)

team.ambiguous.say: More than one of your agents has that name; tell me which.

slots.reason: the detail in the tool's result, or 'it is not available here'

team.no_agents.say: I don't see any agents for you.

team.self.say: That's me, so I haven't sent anything.

slots.note: ' ' + the note in the tool's result, first letter capitalised, + '.' when there is one, else empty

team.unreachable.say: I couldn't reach that agent just now.

team.will_tell_you.say: I'll tell you what they say.

tools.guard_fallback.say: Let me check that properly: could you tell me once more what you'd like me to do?

tools.owner_only.say: Only my owner can ask me to do that.
